status: Guarded cloud radiance and worker shutdown patch qualified locally; downloadable packages recorded separately.
work_mode: Main thread only; no agents used or reactivated.
implementation: Preserve Low quarter-resolution 96/3 and High half-resolution 192/5 integration and every screen-space cloud sample.
Omit volume marching only from the unused radiance octmap; keep base sky generation. No weather cache, extra texture, quality downgrade or new setting.
EISky reads the owning Environment. Keep full volume for unknown owners, enabled reflection, sky-capable ambient, volumetric fog, aerial-perspective fog or SDFGI.
Menu and Game pass their actual Environment, without changing the existing water/reflection/environment policy.
Native PRE_EXIT_LANGUAGES wake-up: after queues drain, signal still-unacknowledged workers, including when the reporting worker already acknowledged earlier. Normal scheduling unchanged.
limits: Linux Vulkan RTX3090 functional evidence. No Windows RTX4090 Mobile/D3D12 execution or claim that the reported 9 FPS case is fixed.
Optimizes only scenes without a radiance consumer. Gameplay with water reflections or volumetric fog retains the full original cost; menus can still benefit.
Run36 has strict one-level held-frame residuals, also on an original arm. These failures are preserved, not reclassified as passes.
Run36 has no foreign renderer at endpoint snapshots; this is not continuous device isolation. Most functional runs overlap foreign rendering work and make no performance claim.
Native regression covers four successful process exits after an intermittent reproducible failure, not exhaustive thread scheduling or platform coverage.
Frozen view fixture scope text inherits an earlier quarter-resolution description. Its guarded variant actually retains High half resolution.
Unrelated V1 ground-contact scratch changes are excluded and untouched. Original broader handoff/platform/route work remains open.
